I’ll miss more drives if I manually keep track of it, so will continue using this app for now. Only missing 3 business drives in 12 months isn’t terrible. This is why I rated it 4 ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ and not 5. Hope I don’t miss too many more.

content: I’ve been using this app for almost 2 years and while it is descent at tracking mileage, there is definitely room for improvement. My biggest complaint is that it takes a long time to register a trip, sometimes days. I drive a lot and I’d like to categorize a trip while I still remember where I went. Also, if you take a short trip it doesn’t register it. My office is less than a mile from home and it never registers my trips to and from there. Another issue is that once you have several months logged, the toggle button to switch to see your personal vs business trips gets hidden behind the monthly summaries. I can’t tell you how many times I miscategorized a trip and just couldnt get to where I needed to categorize it correctly. Lastly, sometimes it doesn’t log starting and/or end points so I’m left wondering if this was an actual trip i missed or a glitch. If you need to somewhat track your mileage this is a good app to do it. But if you need to keep accurate track, this is not the app.

title: Horribly inaccurate
content: I ran 3 mileage logging apps AT THE SAME TIME. So same exact starting and end point, same trip. MileLogger, Stride, and Driversnote. MileLogger was by far the most inaccurate. MileLogger calculated 12.92 miles, Driversnote calculated 19 miles (no decimals with this app), and Stride calculated 20.86 miles. That’s an almost 8 mile difference between MileLogger and Stride. The location is 8.6 miles from my house. So a perfect round trip backtracking is 17.2 miles, but I took a longer detour on the way back. So how MileLogger got 12.92 is confusing. It’s problem is likely that it automatically starts recording and if it doesn’t kick in immediately you miss several miles. So this app is worthless.

content: The automatic logging works great however you have to remember to go back to app occasionally and swipe each trip to the right in order to log each trip as business. This takes about 3 seconds for each one which doesn't sound like a lot until you have 3000 trips stacked up which is not hard to do because each actual trip gets broken down into multiple trips with this apps logistics. So now I am forced to spend about 2hrs of nothing but swiping right or petition the app developers to add a multi selection method or default automatic logging.

title: No support
content: I like this app but twice I’ve had to delete it and start over in the last 10 months.  This requires me to do an export for my records because it deletes all the data.
